findings.category: Public API coverage and task ownership
findings.location: T009-T012, T036-T037, dependency order, ownership map, and traceability matrix (lines 36-39, 81-82, 108-145)
findings.affected_requirement: User Story 1 acceptance scenarios 1-5; FR-001 through FR-008; PR-001 closure; pass1-api Start, Update concurrency, and Status contracts
findings.evidence: The accepted plan defines authenticated public POST Start, PATCH concurrency-update, and GET status endpoints and explicitly assigns the active-concurrency public seam to Pass1ConcurrencyUpdateTests plus the PATCH endpoint. The corrected tasks give T009-T012 only store tests/implementation, while the only API RED/GREEN pair T036/T037 is expressly limited to recovery/resume and cites FR-039/043/044 rather than FR-001-FR-008. No task owns Start, Update concurrency, or Status request/response validation, authentication/ManagementAccess/dual-Repository ownership nondisclosure, ProblemDetails mapping, coordinator composition, endpoint registration, or their public-seam tests. The traceability matrix's textual FR coverage therefore cannot produce the plan's SystemOwner start surface or the PR-001 authorized active-update seam.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate tasks with an observed public-seam RED and sole-owner GREEN sequence for POST Start, PATCH concurrency update, and GET status, naming exact Shared validator/DTO, Web endpoint/coordinator/registration/Program, and test paths. Cover 401/403/ownership-filtered 404, 400/409/422/503 ProblemDetails, default/1-4 validation, immutable-initial versus effective-limit replay, expected-version actor/ownership races, status/warning ordering, and sanitized responses. Serialize those shared paths in the ownership and dependency maps without weakening the accepted store tests or resume API slice.

findings.location: T006-T008, Exact RED to GREEN ownership map, and Nonbehavioral task classification (lines 25-27, 126-164)
findings.affected_requirement: AD-12 compatibility correction; FR-038/042/044/047/049/056; Constitution IV and accepted plan public-seam TDD rule
findings.evidence: T007 adds observable Scan/coordination state transitions and closed failure/pause behavior before any task is identified as their observed behavioral RED. T006 mentions entity/configuration shape and migration lifecycle qualification but is not marked or mapped as RED and does not explicitly test transition guards, version conditions, terminal immutability, warning-free Complete, or FailedPass1/Pass1Policy semantics. The exact RED/GREEN map omits T006-T008, while the nonbehavioral section calls T006/T008 schema mechanics and then claims every other behavior has an explicit RED. This conflicts with plan.md:249, which requires an observed public-seam RED before every production-behavior change, and permits T007 to write behavior without honest RED evidence.
findings.correction_outcome: Make the AD-12 slice dependency-correct and explicit: add or amend a pre-production RED task that exercises the new ScanExecution and TwoRepositoryScanCoordination transitions, version/time guards, terminal immutability, warning-free completion, FailedPass1/Pass1Policy, and legacy-state preservation; pair it with the exact T007/T008 GREEN owners and migration lifecycle proof. Update the RED/GREEN map and nonbehavioral classification so schema mechanics remain truthful but production state behavior cannot precede an observed failure.

summary: REVISE. Fresh independent combined definition review attempt 2 ran the required non-destructive speckit-analyze checks against the dispatch-pinned Story 12.3 feature after the generic prerequisite helper again selected the older Story 12.2 directory from the non-SpecKit branch name. The pinned branch demo0831/story-12-3, full HEAD 9d763845b311e7b5e8ae23fa78c24631233f9840, empty index, spec hash 7dba4ddf1d808dd6327468920d8ae2e0bf8130881a95c10166858c407e2f98a1, plan hash f913da57b120faa9a64e21d380b08159d2bdfcab9b3f5e37e60dfe7cbdca0c41, corrected tasks hash ae2c3c816e86d1eead96b9b030f2e15219f18337ee4e2bfcb955472dff5b7f82, and 21-artifact nonrecursive boundary were independently revalidated. DR1-001 is closed: T003 now solely creates and embeds the v2 prompt before T014/T020/T025. DR1-002 is closed: phase summaries, parallel markers, RED/GREEN ownership, and T023 post-GREEN qualification are now consistent.
